title: CodeProbe: Evidence contracts for measurement, policy and source localisation in heuristic code review
description: CodeProbe v2.3.0 integrates a bounded evidence-contract route that separates observation availability, measured values, interpretation policy, source localisation and consumer admission while retaining the formative-review application as a compatibility surface. It is not an empirically validated AI-authorship or misconduct detector. This metadata file does not authorise or assert a Zenodo deposit.
